title: The local structure statement for a finite type module flat at a point, without the finite presentation hypothesis
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite type variant of the local structure statement: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the image point there is an open subscheme of the base change containing the unique point over the given point on which the pullback of the module is flat (statement lines 2700-2720, tag 05I2-adjacent). The proof embeds the source into an affine space over the base, applies the finite presentation version to the pushforward of the module along that closed immersion, and then intersects the resulting open subscheme with the base change of the source. The reduction through the affine space is the substance, so the claim is H2.
